text:
david: Heads up — nightly e2e perf gate failed on main at 1804512345. p95 latency jumped ~18% vs baseline. Full run: https://ci.redwood/example/1804512345 :thinking:
carla: Yikes. Which test group? can you paste the failing metric snippet?
alice: saw the alert. looks like the long-tail for chat-infer increased. p95 from 210ms -> 248ms.
david: exact log snippet:
```
TEST_GROUP: e2e/chat
METRIC: p95_latency_ms
BASELINE: 210.3
CURRENT: 247.8
DELTA: +17.96%
```
bob: tagging @alice @carla — I can kick a rerun now if you want.
carla: please rerun, and can we run with --trace-allocs to capture any memory-pressure anomalies?
jenkins-bot: Triggered rebuild #1804512346 by bob — running e2e/nightly (with trace) · https://ci.redwood/example/1804512346
ci-bot: Note: there were 3 test flakes in the last 24h on that suite. filing for visibility.
david: thanks. also, quick bisect thought: we merged batching changes in PR #4193 yesterday — any chance that's related?
alice: hmm that PR adjusted dynamic batching window and KV cache prefetch ordering. I'd put it as suspect but need data.
carla: can someone compare trace+profile from the failing job vs a green baseline run? I don't have access atm.
bob: grabbing profiles now, will diff and post highlights.
bob: quick diff summary: increased context switch count and higher memcpy time in runtime/batching.cpp around commit 9d2f5a7. attaching stack sample: `runtime::batcher::dispatch` -> `kvcache::prefetch` :mag:
david: good catch. @eng-sre-bot can we pin a temp rollback to isolate? If bisect confirms, we should revert the batching change for the night runs.
eng-sre-bot: Created rollback PR draft: redwood/repo@rollback-batching-180451 — awaiting review.
alice: I'll run a targeted bisect job over commits between 9d2f5a7..HEAD with the e2e/nightly profile enabled. ETA ~30m.
jenkins-bot: Bisect job queued #1804512355 (range 9d2f5a7..HEAD). Will post progress.
ci-bot: Rerun (1804512346) finished — still failed, p95 249ms. Trace uploaded: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/1804512346/trace.zip
david: OK — if bisect hits the batching commit, let's revert for the stable branch and do a follow-up patch with safer prefetch limits.
alice: bisect update: narrowed to commit 9d2f5a7 -> confirmed. Reproduces consistently with trace-enabled runs.
carla: action items: 1) revert batching PR on stable (david) 2) add stress/latency test for prefetch path (alice) 3) postmortem draft after revert (me)
david: reverting now and will monitor next nightly. thanks all. :thumbsup:
jenkins-bot: Rollback PR merged to stable (commit cf8b1a2). Nightly will run as scheduled.
bob: monitoring metrics dashboard now — will report if p95 drops back near baseline.
ci-bot: Nightly run (post-rollback) scheduled: 1804590000
bob: initial look — p95 back to 212ms on the quick smoke run. closing triage unless anything else crops up.
carla: thanks team — will start the postmortem doc and link it here when ready.
